senses.gloss: , (denom. of לִיסְטֵיס) to attack, as a free-booter, to commit robbery.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1">Ex. R. s. 1</cite>, beg. <he>היה מְלַסְטֵס את הבריות</he> attacked and robbed the people.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 72a:1">Snh. 72ᵃ</cite> <he>יוצא לפרשת דרכים ומְלַסְטֵם וכ׳</he> he will go out to the cross-roads and rob &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 930">Yalk. Deut. 930</cite>.
